R0_Height20.title: Height in centimeters at 20 years old
R0_Height20.x-derivation: Derived from the RecordedHeights entry where R0_RecHght_Num == '20'. Height is set to R0_HghtAge_Cm if it is present and >0; otherwise it is calculated from imperial inputs as R0_HghtAge_Ft*30.48 + R0_HghtAge_In*2.54 when either imperial component is present and the converted value is >0; otherwise null. No discrepancy check is applied when both metric and imperial values are present. Derived from: R0_RecWght_Num, R0_HghtAge_Ft, R0_HghtAge_In, R0_HghtAge_Cm

R0_Weight20.title: Weight in kilograms at 20 years old
R0_Weight20.x-derivation: Derived from the RecordedWeights entry where R0_RecWght_Num == '20'. Weight is set to R0_WghtAge_Kg if it is present and >0; otherwise it is calculated from imperial inputs as R0_WghtAge_St*6.35029318 + R0_WghtAge_Lbs*0.45359237 when either imperial component is present and the converted value is >0; otherwise null. No discrepancy check is applied when both metric and imperial values are present. Derived from: R0_RecWght_Num, R0_WghtAge_St, R0_WghtAge_Lbs, R0_WghtAge_Kg

R0_BMI20.title: BMI at 20 years old.
R0_BMI20.x-derivation: Body Mass Index (kg/m²) at age 20. If AgeEntry < 20 or R0_PregAt20 == 1, BMI is set to 9999. Otherwise BMI is calculated as R0_Weight20 / ((R0_Height20 / 100)^2) when both derived measures are present and >0; otherwise null. BMI is rounded to 1 decimal place. Calculation: R0_Weight20 / ((R0_Height20 / 100) ^ 2) Derived from: R0_Height20, R0_Weight20, R0_PregAt20, AgeEntry

R0_Height.title: Height in centimeters at baseline
R0_Height.x-derivation: Derived from current height inputs in PhysicalDevelopment. Height is set to R0_CurrentHght_Cm if it is present and >0; otherwise it is calculated from imperial inputs as R0_CurrentHght_Ft*30.48 + R0_CurrentHght_In*2.54 when either imperial component is present and the converted value is >0; otherwise null. No discrepancy check is applied when both metric and imperial values are present. Derived from: R0_CurrentHght_Ft, R0_CurrentHght_In, R0_CurrentHght_Cm

R0_Weight.title: Weight in kilograms at baseline
R0_Weight.x-derivation: Derived from current weight inputs in PhysicalDevelopment. Weight is set to R0_CurrentWght_Kg if it is present and >0; otherwise it is calculated from imperial inputs as R0_CurrentWght_St*6.35029318 + R0_CurrentWght_Lbs*0.45359237 when either imperial component is present and the converted value is >0; otherwise null. No discrepancy check is applied when both metric and imperial values are present. Derived from: R0_CurrentWght_St, R0_CurrentWght_Lbs, R0_CurrentWght_Kg

R0_BMI.title: BMI at baseline
R0_BMI.x-derivation: Body Mass Index (kg/m²) at baseline. If R0_CurrentPreg == 1, BMI is set to 9999. Otherwise BMI is calculated as weight_kg / (height_m^2) using derived R0_Weight and R0_Height when both are present and >0; otherwise null. BMI is rounded to 1 decimal place. Calculation: R0_Weight / ((R0_Height / 100) ^ 2) Derived from: R0_Height, R0_Weight, R0_CurrentPreg

R0_HighestWeight.title: Greatest non-pregnant weight since age 18 (kg)
R0_HighestWeight.x-derivation: Derived from greatest non-pregnant weight since age 18 in PhysicalDevelopment. Weight is set to R0_HighestWght_Kg if it is present and >0; otherwise it is calculated from imperial inputs as R0_HighestWght_St*6.35029318 + R0_HighestWght_Lbs*0.45359237 when either imperial component is present and the converted value is >0; otherwise null. Derived from: R0_HighestWght_St, R0_HighestWght_Lbs, R0_HighestWght_Kg

R0_HighestWeightAge.title: Age at greatest non-pregnant weight since age 18, in whole years
R0_HighestWeightAge.x-derivation: Transfer from PhysicalDevelopment.R0_HighestWght_Age (no transformation). Derived from: R0_HighestWght_Age
R0_HighestWeightAge.$comment: Legacy name: bodysizewtgreatage. Upper bound is a plausibility bound the source does not state -- agent-decided.

R0_WaistCircum.title: Waist circumference in centimeters at baseline
R0_WaistCircum.x-derivation: Derived from waist circumference inputs in PhysicalDevelopment. Waist circumference is calculated from R0_WaistCircum_In*2.54 when inches is present and >0; otherwise R0_WaistCircum_Cm is used when present and >0; otherwise null. The selected value is rounded to 2 decimal places. Derived from: R0_WaistCircum_In, R0_WaistCircum_Cm

R0_HipCircum.title: Hip circumference in centimeters at baseline
R0_HipCircum.x-derivation: Derived from hip circumference inputs in PhysicalDevelopment. Hip circumference is calculated from R0_HipCircum_In*2.54 when inches is present and >0; otherwise R0_HipCircum_Cm is used when present and >0; otherwise null. The selected value is rounded to 2 decimal places. Derived from: R0_HipCircum_In, R0_HipCircum_Cm

R0_WaistHipRatio.title: Waist-to-hip ratio at baseline
R0_WaistHipRatio.x-derivation: Waist-to-hip ratio at baseline. If R0_CurrentPreg == 1, the value is set to 9999. Otherwise it is calculated as R0_WaistCircum / R0_HipCircum when both derived measurements are present and R0_HipCircum > 0; otherwise null. The ratio is rounded to 2 decimal places. Calculation: R0_WaistCircum / R0_HipCircum Derived from: R0_WaistCircum, R0_HipCircum, R0_CurrentPreg
